attchmntText: Dc Infotech And Communication Limited has informed the Exchange about Newspaper Advertisements - Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: DC Infotech and Communication Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published on November 07, 2026, in Pratahkal, the Marathi Mumbai Edition, and in Active Times, the English All Edition. The filing was signed by Director Chetankumar Timbadia, holding DIN 06731478. The document includes a summary of financial figures in lakhs, reporting total income of 21,362.08 for the quarter and 38,186.53 for the half year. Net profit after tax was reported as 580.46 for the quarter and 1,033.83 for the half year. Earnings per share were 3.46 for the quarter and 6.30 for the half year. The company's registered office is located in Andheri East, Mumbai.
